items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: But we had all these vocalese things. And with my alto player, George Davis.

ctx.x: composer. So we said let’s do something similar to that, in our own way. So he started writing some little arrangements for us, which were generally the tune first, with the lyrics, and then it went into a vocalese part. And we had quite a few in our repertoire, and that’s actually when Charlie Ventura heard us, at a Dave Garroway concert.

Dave would present concerts in Chicago. He would have a nationally famous jazz group, and then a local jazz group. And so we came in there ready man. We were loaded for bear — you know — yeah, we can do it. And God we were so young and unknowing. But we had all these vocalese things. And with my alto player, George Davis. So we did these things, and we poured it on hot baby, and the group, it was really good. It was good.
